generationRequest.prompt: Use case: edit this exact 2D bone-wall sprite to its REVEALED static state after removal of old membrane. Preserve exact same canvas dimensions, same outer bone wall silhouette, margins, border, side-view camera, crack near upper right and matte painted texture. Remove ONLY the dull blue-gray membrane covering the broad front face. Reveal warm pale ivory bone underneath and several clearly carved long flowing PARALLEL sound-memory grooves across the wall, at different irregular spacing like old layered wave paths following the bone curvature. These dark shallow curved incisions are tactile engraved grooves, not written symbols or literal sound wave icons. Make a clear material change from blue opaque film to exposed ivory grooved bone. No whale drawings, words, runes, figures, new motifs, glowing lines, aura or loose peeled fragments. No character or scene. All outside remains real transparent.

method: 内置 imagegen 逐件生成或参考引导静态状态修改；原始 PNG 未裁切、降噪或抠图。
